svg.title: Figure 2 — Both airborne runs — synthetic sample — not a measurement
svg.desc: synthetic sample — not a measurement. One chart overlays the eight sensor series from each of the two airborne sample runs by point index. Solid and dashed lines distinguish the runs; sensor markers and colours distinguish sensors; point 0 is excluded.
